# Verifiable Expands Its Network Monitoring Suite, Giving Healthcare Leaders Unparalleled Visibility Into Provider Sanctions and Exclusions

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f3eaa1cc8ef1556e6479115/67632df0140b7613a340bbc0_Verifiable-logo.avif)

March 13, 2025 (Austin, TX)

SHARE THIS ARTICLE

## _The New Capabilities Will Help Healthcare Organizations Meet Updated NCQA Compliance Guidelines and Ensure Care Quality_

‍

Verifiable, an innovative category disruptor in the provider network management software category, today announced the expansion of its [Network Monitoring Suite](https://verifiable.com/provider-network-monitoring). This update further empowers healthcare organizations with the actionable insights they need to maintain compliance and ensure patient quality with greater efficiency. With this update, healthcare leaders can automate monitoring sanctions and exclusions (S&E) sources in bulk, gain detailed visibility into gaps and verification failures, and take swift action to maintain compliance.

‍

The expansion comes at the precipice of a new set of guidelines from the [National Committee for Quality Assurance](https://www.ncqa.org/programs/health-plans/policy-accreditation-and-certification/) (NCQA), set to take effect in July, requiring healthcare organizations to monitor SAM and Medicare and Medicaid Exclusions sources every 30 days. Leveraging Verifiable’s always-on S&E monitoring solution, healthcare leaders can maintain peace of mind as regulations tighten and scale their operations with ease.

‍

**Verifiable’s Network Monitoring Suite includes:**

- **_Self-Serve Reporting & Insights:_** Access pre-built configurable reports and dashboards to monitor the health of a provider network
- **_Real-Time Integrated Verifications:_** Consolidate NCQA-compliant primary sources to simplify checks and receive provider updates in real-time
- **_Proactive Provider Expiration Notifications:_** Notify providers of upcoming credential expirations with easy instructions on remaining in good standing
- **_Match Review & Intervention Management:_** Enable investigations, termination actions, and sanction exclusion approvals to address or suppress hits quickly

‍

“As regulations continue to tighten, it’ll be critical for healthcare organizations to transform from the status quo of manual processes and automate ongoing monitoring for large provider networks,” said Brook West, President of Verifiable. “Our platform enables our customers to truly build a state-of-the-art compliance program and stay ahead of the curve.”

‍

Over the past five years, Verifiable has helped 150+ leading healthcare organizations across the U.S. scale credentialing operations, streamline provider enrollment, and adopt always-on compliance monitoring. With 3200+ fully integrated sources, the company processes over 5 million monthly verifications in seconds.

‍

To learn how Verifiable’s credentialing and monitoring solutions can streamline your operations, visit [https://verifiable.com](https://verifiable.com/).

‍

#### About Verifiable

Verifiable is a credentialing and network monitoring platform built to help healthcare organizations optimize operations for error-free, fast verifications and maintain compliance with ease. Backed by NCQA certified in-house experts with 60+ years of combined experience, Verifiable supports and manages trusted networks at scale through instant 97% verification automation, with millions of verifications processed each month. Verifiable works with leading healthcare organizations such as Humana Dental, Zelis, Talkspace, Headway, Empower Pharmacy, and many others.
